response.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT sc.*, s.healtheval FROM scanconservation sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), status_groups AS (SELECT healtheval, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM joined GROUP BY healtheval), total_sum AS (SELECT SUM(cnt)::float as total_cnt FROM status_groups), with_shares AS (SELECT healtheval, cnt, cnt::float / (SELECT total_cnt FROM total_sum) as share FROM status_groups), avg_share_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares), above_avg AS (SELECT cnt, share, (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc) as overall_avg_share FROM with_shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc)) SELECT AVG(cnt)::float as avg_count, AVG(share)::float as avg_share, AVG(share - overall_avg_share)::float as avg_excess FROM above_avg
